# Getting Support for Nexura Security

If you need help with Nexura Security, you have several options depending on your needs.

## Free Version Support

If you are using the free version of Nexura Security, please use the community forums:

* **WordPress.org Forums:** The best place to ask questions, report non-security bugs, and get help from the community. [Visit our Support Forum](https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/nexura-security).

## Premium Support (Pro Users)

If you have upgraded to Nexura Security Pro, you get priority support directly from our security experts:

* **Email Support:** Reach out to us at **support@nexurasecurity.com**.
* **Support Ticket:** Open a ticket from your Nexura Security account dashboard.

When contacting support, please include your site URL, WordPress version, and a detailed description of the issue.

## General & Sales Inquiries

* **General questions:** contact@nexurasecurity.com
* **Sales & Upgrades:** sales@nexurasecurity.com

We're here to help keep your WordPress site safe!
